name: Spirit-Gem
description: A gem tied to Ugin and the Meditation Realm, taken by Bolas and later stolen by Jace.

timeline.summary: While the others are distracted, Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and begins casting his spell.
timeline.quote: He secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole his Spirit-Gem .

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse

timeline.summary: Liliana takes Bolas's Spirit-Gem and leaves Ravnica.
timeline.quote: She took Bolas's Spirit-Gem and planeswalked away

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mistress Vess collars Liliana and takes the Spirit-Gem.
timeline.quote: A gold collar was placed around her neck, and the Spirit-Gem was taken.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana gives up the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Bolas's faked death, Ugin secretly takes the mortal Bolas to the realm, reveals the Spirit-Gem and strips him of both names.
timeline.quote: Ugin then took away both of Bolas's names and rendered the fallen one nameless.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and casts a spell to reshape the realm; unable to sustain it, he shatters like glass as reality unmakes.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Jace's spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas kills Ugin, finds the Spirit-Gem in the Meditation Realm and claims it, wearing it for millennia.
timeline.quote: Bolas found the gem in the Meditation Realm after killing his brother Ugin

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Bolas's defeat Liliana picks up the Spirit-Gem before planeswalking away.
timeline.quote: After Bolas's defeat, Liliana Vess picked up the Spirit-Gem before she planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Holding the Gem and the Chain Veil, Liliana sees the Gem glow and disappear; she drops the Veil and the Gem returns to Ugin.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace secretly steals the Spirit-Gem from behind Ugin and casts a reality-altering spell.
timeline.quote: He secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole the Spirit-Gem.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin conspires with Sarkhan, retakes the Meditation Realm and gains a way to spy through the Spirit-Gem on Bolas.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan helped Ugin bypass the wards that Bolas used to protect the Meditation Realm

citation.text: "Ugin", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin speaks to Araithia and Liliana through the Spirit-Gem, and Liliana gives up the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace steals the Spirit-Gem and casts a reality-bending spell that fails and unmakes him.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Rediscovered". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
